versions.content: The SubscribeEventgroupNegativeAcknowledgment entry type shall be used to indicate that a valid SubscribeEventgroup (see SWS_SD_00476) entry was NOT accepted. It shall be always sent instead of a SubscribeEventgroupAck if such an error occurred. Reasons for sending a SubscribeEventgroupNegativeAcknowledgment include: • Combination of Service ID, Instance ID, Eventgroup ID, and Major Version is unknown • Required TCP-connection was not opened by client • Problems with the references options occurred (wrong values, missing endpoint, or conflicting endpoints) • Resource problems at the Server
